source: Zhou et al. 2026, Annals of Carnegie Museum 92, Fig. 6A: strict consensus of dromaeosaurid relationships with Jian changmaensis (bold, silhouette); rectangular with rounded corners, root left. Panel B (another analysis, with support values) is excluded. Image: census figure (2020x1708 px), the embedded raster.
region_note: panel A; panel B to its right repeats the taxa under another analysis
license: unverified: no licence statement in the text held
names_note: the census list of the paper's matrix taxa, plus the printed forms; every printed tip maps to one matrix taxon. 'Neuquenraptor argentinus' is printed with an asterisk keyed to '+ Unenlagia spp.' (the matrix's 'Neuquenraptor argentinus Unenlagia spp'), and is listed without the asterisk
gold_note: Dromaeosaurid strict consensus, panel A. Two large fans: nine microraptorines leave one vertical (stem entering at Hesperonychus' height) and fourteen eudromaeosaurs another (stem at Velociraptor mongoliensis' height), each read as one node with the entered line as a child, as in earlier batches. No clade names are printed. 34 tips, 2 polytomies (9, 14 children). Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
